visualCharacteristics.summary: Brand logo tiles with 'Angebote anzeigen' links
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Brand offers grid — large grey logo boxes with a bold text link centred under each (one row of 7 at >= 1200px, 4-up at >= 768px, 2-up below); the whole tile is clickable. The section head (eyebrow + `<h2>`) is default content before the block and is reabsorbed (eyebrow | headline)
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: Row model matches (picture | link) but visual is a 7-up grid of large grey logo boxes vs three 32px-icon stage tiles; purpose differs.
